{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Control

|descr= Sets the target depth level for swimming soldier. Depth should be a negative number.

|s1= unit [[swimInDepth]] value

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= value: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>soldier swimInDepth -20;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>
bob swimInDepth -10;
bob doMove ASLToAGL getPosASL player;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[underwater]]
}}
